'''Ailon''' was a heavily-fortified [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Ailon system/Legends|Ailon system]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].

==History==
Ailon joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] early in its history, sometime between [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] and [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Ailon (species)/Legends|Ailon]], they established the famed [[Ailon Nova Guard/Legends|Ailon Nova Guard]] in [[13,000 BBY]].
